tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (readability extraction): title, url, final_url, markdown, word_count. HTML, plain text, Markdown, JSON and XML. Static fetch only (no JavaScript rendering). Respects robots.txt, blocks private/loopback/metadata hosts, max 3 MB /

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Fetch a public PDF (max 10 MB) and convert it to Markdown with Cloudflare Workers AI toMarkdown. Returns title (if detected), url, markdown, word_count. Same URL safety rules as read_url. Failed conversions are not charged. Costs $0.006 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe a public direct audio file URL (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg/opus, flac; max 25 MB and 10 minutes, checked from the file header before transcription) with Whisper (@cf/openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo) on Cloudflare Workers AI. Returns text, language, duration, segments with timestamps, optional SRT/V

Optional from_year / to

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "read_url_safe" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Same as read_url plus a heuristic prompt-injection check: flags hidden/invisible text, instruction-like phrases ("ignore previous instructions", role reassignme…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "read_url_safe" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
